notes.title: August pre Shadow of Nichishima patch
notes.content:
[b]Thank you![/b]
Firstly we would just like to say thank you for playing, reviewing and helping us make our game better with your feedback. We are always looking to improve the experience for our players and listen to your experiences. 

[b]What's new![/b]
This patch is bigger than usual as we are preparing for our new chapter Shadow of Nichishima which will be a free content update planned for this Halloween. Here is a list of updates in this patch:
- Fixed issue with the Onsen door (This will only open once you have escaped the house)
- Improved lighting and atmosphere (We listened to feedback saying it was too dark when outside)
- New subtle VHS filter effect (Simple press P to toggle it)
- Fixed event trigger issues (Some encounters have been fixed and adjusted)
- Some additional audio effects have been added
- Player interact icon colour changed to improve visibility

[b]What's next[/b]
The next update will bring a whole new chapter with hours of content, to tease this we added the filter option, but this is not going to be the same one used in Shadow of Nichishima. We thank you all for your support and hope you continue to enjoy the updates. We are a very small team and we know sometimes we will make mistakes and get things wrong, but we always aim to improve and listen to our players.

notes.title: New content update in the works!
notes.content: [p][b][i][u]Shadows of NIchishima[/u][/i][/b] [/p][p]A new terror awaits in the next chapter of The Ghost of Nichishima! Set in the 90s, play as urban explorers uncovering the abandoned ruins of Nichishima, a village haunted by a disaster. Face a spine chilling new enemy in this found-footage-inspired horror experience. [/p][p][/p][p]This chapter will be a free update to the game, no DLC required. It will be accessed from the main menu when released. [/p][p][/p][p]We want to deliver more stories across different times and characters, each with their own slice of the horror genre. Thank you for your support and patience as we work on more content before the main game is released. [/p][p][/p][p]We have put in the work to bring a more visually realistic and atmospheric look to the game as well as refine the experience based on player feedback. notes.title: 7th May Patch
notes.content:
- Lumen is now enabled and is optional in the settings (We do not advise Lumen illuminations due to it increasing the amount of light.)

- Max FPS increased! Issue fixed where fps wouldn't go over 60 

We are still working on photo mode but these new light and reflection settings will help improve visual quality  for when it is released.

- Fixed issue where game over cut scene triggered after defeating Yurei

- Fixed broke animation where hands would appear on screen

Please remember to use TAB to check current quest and keep hints/subtitles turned on for first play through. 

Be aware the cups are NOT de-spawning, this is not a glitch and is intended, simply proceed with the bedroom task :)

notes.title: March 2025 Patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Thank you to everyone who has played the game and given feedback, we are listening! [/b]

This patch expands the prologue, fixes bugs and offers more guidance as we noticed players were struggling with one of the first puzzles. We want more players to finish the experience so here is a run down of what this patch brings. 

- Updated village level design
- Bug fixes 
- New way to save your game manually using device located in the office (removed most autosaves)
- More creepy encounters
- Added guidance
- Voice lines have been added for Tsuki
- Improved and updated localising 

[b]Things to note that will improve the experience:[/b]
- Start a new game and delete old saves (when too many saves it can trigger fatal error)
- Play in borderless window mode (this seems to remove the stutter as we work on solution)
- Update graphics drivers 

[b]What is on the way:[/b]
- Performance mode is in the works
- Photo mode is in the works (this will be a separate mode)
- More voice lines and Japanese VO
- The free survival horror DLC to anyone who owns early access

[b]We are aware of some issues that we have mentioned and we are working on fixes so thank you for your patience and support! [/b]

[b]ゲームをプレイしてフィードバックをくださった皆さんに感謝します。私たちは耳を傾けています！[/b]
このパッチでは、プロローグを拡張し、バグを修正し、最初の謎解きでプレイヤーが苦戦していることに気付いたため、さらにガイダンスを追加しました。私たちはより多くのプレイヤーにこの体験を最後まで楽しんでほしいと考えています。以下に、このパッチで追加される内容をまとめました。
村のレベルデザインを更新

バグ修正

オフィスにあるデバイスを使用した新しい手動セーブ方法（ほとんどのオートセーブを削除）

さらに不気味な遭遇イベントを追加

ガイダンスを追加

ツキのボイスラインを追加

ローカライズの改善と更新

[b]体験を向上させるために注意すべき点:[/b]
新しいゲームを開始し、古いセーブデータを削除してください（セーブデータが多すぎると致命的なエラーが発生する可能性があります）

ボーダーレスウィンドウモードでプレイしてください（これにより、現在解決策を模索中のカクつきが解消されるようです）

グラフィックドライバーを更新してください

[b]今後予定されているもの:[/b]
パフォーマンスモードを開発中

フォトモードを開発中（これは別モードになります）

さらに多くのボイスラインと日本語音声を追加

アーリーアクセスを所有している方全員に無料のサバイバルホラーDLCを提供

[b]私たちは上記で触れた一部の問題を認識しており、修正に取り組んでいます。皆様の我慢とサポートに感謝します！[/b]

notes.title: Explore the past of Nichishima in the upcoming free DLC
notes.content:
[b]Thank you![/b]
First of all, we’d like to thank everyone who has supported us through Early Access so far and provided valuable feedback.

We’re continuing to update the prologue with additional guidance (some optional), enhanced localization, and improved performance. We’ve already added secrets and plan to include more extra content to keep you engaged until our next major update.

[b]We have listened[/b]
We’ve listened to your feedback and rolled out updates quickly, but as the next chapter approaches, we want you to help shape its direction. That’s why we’re thrilled to announce that we’re releasing the prequel chapter as free DLC for all Early Access supporters! This chapter is in development and will be released before the main story update, allowing us to deliver more of the main story at once instead of in smaller sections.

[b]Welcome to Nichishima[/b]
Travel to the haunted past of Nichishima, a village lost to 1960s Japan, in this prequel to the main game. In your final school year as a newcomer, a classmate vanishes, pulling you into a chilling mystery. What begins as a desperate search soon spirals into a third-person survival horror nightmare, where reality unravels and truths lie hidden in the mist. Can you escape your fate, or will Nichishima claim you forever?

We hope you enjoy the upcoming updates to the prologue and the new expansion. Thank you for joining us on this journey—we can’t wait to share more of the Nichishima story with you!


[b]ありがとう！[/b]
まず初めに、これまでアーリーアクセスを通じて私たちをサポートし、貴重なフィードバックをくださった皆様に感謝申し上げます。  

私たちはプロローグのアップデートを継続しており、追加のガイダンス（一部は任意）、改良されたローカライズ、パフォーマンスの向上を行っています。すでに隠し要素を追加しており、次の大きなアップデートまで皆様を楽しませるために、さらに多くの追加コンテンツを計画しています。  

[b]皆様の声に耳を傾けました[/b]
皆様からのフィードバックを聞き、迅速にアップデートを実施してきましたが、次の章が近づくにつれ、その方向性を皆様と一緒に形作っていきたいと考えています。そのため、アーリーアクセスのすべてのサポーター向けに、前日譚となる章を無料DLCとしてリリースすることを発表できることを嬉しく思います！この章は現在開発中で、メインストーリーのアップデートの前にリリースされる予定です。これにより、メインストーリーを細切れにするのではなく、一度に多くの内容をお届けできるようになります。  

[b]ニチシマへようこそ[/b]
本編ゲームの前日譚として、1960年代の日本で忘れ去られた村・ニチシマの幽霊が宿る過去へと旅立ってください。新入生として最後の学年を迎えたあなたは、クラスメイトが失踪したことから、不気味な謎に引き込まれます。必死の捜索から始まった出来事は、やがて三人称視点のサバイバルホラーへと発展し、現実が崩れ落ち、真実が霧の中に隠されています。あなたは運命から逃れられるのか、それともニチシマに永遠に囚われてしまうのか？  

プロローグの今後のアップデートと新しい拡張コンテンツを楽しんでいただければ幸いです。この旅に同行してくださりありがとうございます。ニチシマの物語をもっと皆様と共有できる日が待ち遠しいです！

notes.title: Early access release!
notes.content:
[b]Are you ready to arrive in Nichishima? [/b]
The time is nearly upon us to release our game, we plan to release for Lunar new year at the end of this month (January 29th 2025). We have listened to feedback from the demo and used it to make a stronger foundation for the game. 

[b]What will early access contain?[/b]
Early access will launch with a new prologue chapter where you play as Tsuki, the house keeper of one of the homes in Nichishima. It's her first day on the job and when a storm roles in, it leads to you having to investigate the homes off limits rooms and uncover its secrets. This chapter will allow you to get an idea of the scale of the village as you walk around and will directly lead to the events of the main story. If you purchase the early access you will be able to play new parts of the story and explore new parts of the village over time, until the full release. 

[b]Our ambition[/b]
We plan to keep working on the game to bring you a satisfying and complete experience, we did not plan for early access but due to funding we must. With your support we will bring our vision to life and bring you a horror game with depth, lore and a full , hauntingly beautiful village to explore. The true story will be uncovered through the game and we hope you enjoy uncovering the mystery of Nichishima. Thank you to anyone who supports us, as a small indie studio we are excited and nervous about this venture, so your support means everything to us. We will make mistakes along the way but we proved with our demo how dedicated we are to improving the game and listening to feedback.

notes.title: The next chapter
notes.content:
First we would like to say that we appreciate those who played the demo and who gave feedback. We are aware there were issues and we fixed problems with multiple patches through Next Fest as fast as we could. We would like to explain the current state of the demo and help bring some clarity as well as address issues. The latest patch is very different from the first and whilst most liked this version it did leave some questions. 

[b]Why the change? [/b]We wanted to try different lighting, give players a body and even worked on introducing a different character to play as for part of the game. Most players preferred the new torch and lighting, graphics and having a full body mesh for the player. This has come with its issues and challenges as some of you may have noticed with the model. There may also be some confusion with why the character change, we wanted to try these new features whilst we had the demo live so we can collect feedback in time for the next stage which we will get into below. The demo will be taken down as we focus on development and go through feedback. 

[b]What is the next step? [/b]
We are now working on bringing the game into early access where the game will be broken down into chapters and updates adding more to the village. We are aiming to release early access this coming December/January. 

The first stage will be to launch in early access with the Prologue, this will follow the housekeeper who has been hired by the neighbour. It will lead up to the events of the main game, giving more lore and depth to the Yurei house. This will be a chapter separate from the main game. 

Main game - The main game will launch with the player home, adding a whole new area to explore and fear. You will have access to the rest of the village to look around and get an idea of scale and what's to come. This will not have quests for the other areas but will have easter eggs and some extra things to encounter to help tide you over until the next update.

Going forward each update will add new areas to the experience growing in content, playtime and quality.  
This is not how we wanted to go about it, as we wanted it to be a full experience at launch but due to funding this is the only current option. 

We really do appreciate any support and apologise for any issues we had with the demo, it is all about learning and we are willing to put the work in to fix things as we hope players noticed from demo launch to the latest patch. 

We have started a Patreon for anyone who wants to support and secure a copy of the game or get access to content/updates early. https://www.patreon.com/c/SakuraStudiosNorth

notes.title: Demo Patch incoming!
notes.content: Hi everyone! We have been made aware of an issue in the demo where the tape does not play. We found the issue and patched it straight away, but sadly as we recently moved we updated our authenticator to a new device which has suspended us for 72 hours. We was not aware of this suspension for updating security but we are just awaiting Steam to approve the build so we can release the patch with the fix. We are so sorry for this bug and delay in progressing with that part of the demo. We hope Steam approve it fast so you can finish the demo bug free!

notes.title: Yurei the demo launch!
notes.content:
This October our demo will be launching for Steam fest on October 14th! The demo Yurei will be a full experience with easter eggs to find and multiple endings. Even though this is just a taste of what is to come in the main game, we want this to feel like a standalone game in itself. Estimated play time is around 30-45 minutes but there will be secrets for those who want to brave the demo for longer. This will take place in just one of the houses in the village to give an idea of what each location can offer in the main game.

今月の10月14日に、私たちのデモがSteamフェスで発表されます！ デモ版の幽霊は、見つけるべきイースターエッグや複数のエンディングを含む、フル体験となります。 これは本編ゲームの予告に過ぎませんが、私たちはこれが独立したゲームのように感じられることを望んでいます。 推定プレイ時間は約30〜45分ですが、デモを長く楽しみたい方のために秘密も用意されています。 これは村の一つの家で行われ、メインゲームで各ロケーションが提供できるもののアイデアを示します。
